title: OneLake Shortcuts in Lakehouses (typed create, list, delete)
summary: OneLake shortcuts virtualize external/other-OneLake storage into a lakehouse. Create with TYPED flags per target type (9 supported: OneLake, AdlsGen2, AmazonS3, AzureBlobStorage, GoogleCloudStorage, S3Compatible, Dataverse, ExternalDataShare, OneDriveSharePoint); cloud targets need a connection first. list-shortcuts enumerates them (DW-managed internal shortcuts hidden unless --include-managed). load-table resolves shortcut paths even when list-files does not show their contents.

typed_creation.note: create-shortcut takes typed flags describing the target; --target-type is normalized/validated (unknown type errors with the enumerated valid values). --target JSON remains a raw escape hatch.
typed_creation.onelake: fabio lakehouse create-shortcut --workspace $WS --id $LH --name ref --path Tables --target-type OneLake --target-workspace $SRC_WS --target-item $SRC_ITEM --target-path Tables/mytable
typed_creation.adlsgen2: fabio lakehouse create-shortcut --workspace $WS --id $LH --name adls --path Files --target-type AdlsGen2 --connection-id $CONN --location https://ACCOUNT.dfs.core.windows.net/CONTAINER --subpath /sub
typed_creation.amazons3: fabio lakehouse create-shortcut --workspace $WS --id $LH --name s3 --path Files --target-type AmazonS3 --connection-id $CONN --location https://bucket.s3.amazonaws.com --subpath /data
typed_creation.escape_hatch: fabio lakehouse create-shortcut ... --target '<raw JSON matching the Fabric shortcut target schema>'

connection_first.why: Cloud target types (AdlsGen2, AmazonS3, AzureBlobStorage, GoogleCloudStorage, S3Compatible) require a connection; create it first and pass its id via --connection-id. OneLake/ExternalDataShare targets do not.
connection_first.step_1_create_connection: fabio connection create --name "my-adls" --connectivity-type ShareableCloud --connection-type AzureDataLakeStorage --server "https://ACCOUNT.dfs.core.windows.net" --path "/CONTAINER" --credential-type Key --credential-key "$STORAGE_KEY" --skip-test
connection_first.server: The DFS endpoint WITHOUT the container: https://ACCOUNT.dfs.core.windows.net
connection_first.skip_test: Add --skip-test to avoid connection validation during creation (faster)

list_and_delete.list: fabio lakehouse list-shortcuts --workspace $WS --id $LH [--parent-path Tables] — paginated. DW-managed internal OneLake->OneLake shortcuts under Tables/ are hidden unless --include-managed.
list_and_delete.delete_directory: fabio lakehouse delete-directory --workspace $WS --id $LH --path Files/sub — recursive OneLake directory delete (destructive, --dry-run-guarded). fabio REFUSES an empty/root path (that would wipe the whole lakehouse).

known_behaviors.list_files_limitation: fabio lakehouse list-files may not show files through a shortcut. The OneLake DFS layer virtualizes the path and may show the lakehouse structure instead of the actual storage contents. This is a Fabric API behavior, not a fabio bug — use list-shortcuts to enumerate shortcuts.
known_behaviors.load_table_works: fabio lakehouse load-table resolves shortcut paths correctly via the Fabric backend. Files at Files/shortcutname/file.csv are accessible for table loading even when list-files does not show them.
known_behaviors.propagation_delay: After creating a shortcut, allow 5-10 seconds before accessing files through it.

what_agents_should_do: Pick the correct --target-type; for cloud targets create the connection first and capture its id.
Use list-shortcuts (not list-files) to enumerate shortcuts; add --include-managed only when you need the DW-managed internal ones.
Do NOT waste time debugging list-files if it doesn't show shortcut contents — proceed to load-table using Files/shortcutname/filename.csv.
If load-table fails with NOT_FOUND, wait 10s and retry (propagation delay).
For directory cleanup use delete-directory with a concrete subpath and --dry-run first (never an empty/root path).

error_patterns.unknown_target_type: An unrecognized --target-type errors with the enumerated valid values — pick one of the 9 supported types.
error_patterns.connection_not_found: Shortcut creation fails if connection-id is invalid. Verify with: fabio connection show --id $CONN_ID
error_patterns.conflict_on_name: A shortcut or directory with the same name already exists. Delete it first: fabio lakehouse delete-shortcut --workspace $WS --id $LH --name NAME --path Files --force
